retraction.reason: Retracted in M41b: Ergue-te, the ultranationalist party founded in 2000 as the Partido Nacional Renovador out of a statute change to the old Partido Renovador Democrático, and dissolved in 2025. It never held a seat, the atlas holds neither the PRD nor any election record that names it, and the leads describe a motto rather than an event.
